title: The Mandalorian's New Ship
subtitle: The Journey of Grogu
description: If there's anything Grogu loves more than the Mandalorian's new, modified NI-Starfighter, it's the speed boost. Together, Grogu and the Mandalorian leave Tatooine in the Mandalorian's new ship, racing into the stars at top speed, headlong into their next thrilling adventure. But where will their journey take them this time?
